The AI Investment Thesis

Overview

Artificial intelligence represents the most significant technological shift since the internet. Companies that build infrastructure for AI workloads are positioned to capture enormous value over the next decade as demand for compute and data pipelines grows exponentially.

Key Evidence

Cloud hyperscalers are reporting accelerating capital expenditure on GPU clusters. Enterprise software vendors are racing to embed AI features, driving up API usage. The marginal cost of intelligence is falling at a rate similar to Moore's Law.

Risks

Regulatory intervention remains the primary tail risk. Concentration risk in Nvidia supply chain could create bottlenecks. Commoditization of foundation models may compress margins faster than expected.
